lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in vertical columns. The centroids are organized in a repeating pattern of approximately 4 to 5 spots per vertical column in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse, elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming a nodal grid structure across the mid-lateral field.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running parallel along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance dorsal edges to shadowed ventral edges.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of smaller, low-intensity high-luminance blobs, distinct from the larger constellation found on the primary flank.
